action_items: MINOR / DOCS: The review request claims 'PRODUCT_CATEGORIES has 17 entries' but the array in /app/vendor-pwa/src/constants/productCategories.js currently has 16 top-level categories (groceries, beverages, dairy, fruits, vegetables, meat, seafood, frozen, bakery, snacks, sweets, baby_care, household, personal_care, pet_supplies, other). This exactly matches the labels the review request enumerates, so the '17' count in the acceptance criteria is off by one OR one category (e.g., Pharma/Health) is intentionally missing. Subcategory count is 101 (100+ ✓). Decide whether to (a) add a 17th category to match the count claim, or (b) correct the acceptance criteria to '16'.

MINOR / DATA: The 3 pre-seeded products on Test shop 3 render 'FRUITS' via findCategory but the 'Fruits' category-filter chip only counts 1 product (the newly created TEST product) — indicating the legacy products' stored `category` field is not the exact id 'fruits' (probably a legacy string like 'Fruits' or 'fresh_fruits'). Not a bug in ProductsPage.jsx (equality check is correct), but the seed data and constants should be reconciled so old products participate in the new category filter chips. Suggestion: run a one-time migration mapping legacy category strings -> new PRODUCT_CATEGORIES ids.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductForm.jsx (759 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider extracting the Variations builder section (~lines 543-733) into a subcomponent for readability.
ProductsPage.jsx handleDelete uses window.confirm() (non-accessible). Same pattern as before, low priority.
WarehousePage.jsx Update stock uses window.prompt() — works and is testable via page.on('dialog'), but not accessible; consider a small inline modal for parity with Close Early modal.

ProductForm normalizeExistingImages seeds sizeKB=0 for existing images, so the total-KB label shows 0 when editing an existing product. Minor UX — could compute size from base64 length if display consistency matters.
Sidebar `nav-stock verify` data-testid contains a space (from label.toLowerCase()); works with attribute selector but is fragile. Consider slugifying (e.g., 'nav-stock-verify').
